Catalogue parameters: twin 145 kW diesels (290 kW total), 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, 150 m / 500 m, hopper 0.6 m³, Kawasaki 112 (two units), 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm, 8000 kg, aggregate 6 cm and below. faqs.question: Is 100 m³/h the SmartBuy mid-size commercial 60–90 m³/h recommendation?
faqs.answer: No. SmartBuy cites 60–90 m³/h as a mid-sized commercial trailer example. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h, 290 kW and 8000 kg. The guide average is not this row.

faqs.question: Does Diesel 120 list a placing boom because 500 m vertical is printed?
faqs.answer: No. ACI PRC-304.2-17 separates trailer pumps from truck-mounted pumps. Diesel 120 is a trailer table: 150 m / 500 m pipeline distance, not a boom reach SKU.
